summary: 11 objections found; 10 have 2 or more mentions and get an answer card.
Top priority: "Per-technician price adds up" (13 deals, 4 public voices, $146,952 pipeline touched, 51.7% of the pipeline in the window).

Deal killers (against the 54.5% overall loss rate): "Competitor A quoted us less" lost 4 of 5 closed deals (80.0%, 25.5 points above); "We need QuickBooks Desktop" lost 3 of 3 closed deals (100.0%, 45.5 points above).
Product gap: "We need QuickBooks Desktop" lost 3 of 3 closed deals; the product facts confirm the limit, so the card qualifies out instead of arguing.
Most common is not the most costly: "Per-technician price adds up" lost 5 of 10 closed deals (50.0%), against 54.5% overall, so reps already answer it; the card keeps that answer consistent.
6 objections should be answered before the call, on a page, in an ad or in a one-pager.

ranked_objections.objection: Our techs won't use an app
My partner has to sign off
The whiteboard and spreadsheet work fine

priority_math: priority = 50 x pipeline touched / $146,952 + 50 x mentions / 17, rounded

their_words.quote: per tech pricing adds up fast with 22 guys

answer_cards.what_is_fair: At 22 or 30 technicians the yearly total is a real number, and it grows with every hire.
answer_cards.ask_back: What do dispatcher time and wasted drives cost you today?

proof.claim: A plumbing customer with 14 technicians cut drive time 18% in its first 60 days

answer_cards.next_step: Run the ROI calculator (P1) with their numbers on the call and send the result the same day.
answer_cards.say_it: Fair, it adds up with every tech. A plumbing customer with 14 technicians cut drive time 18% in its first 60 days. What do dispatcher time and wasted drives cost you today? Let's put your numbers in the calculator now.
answer_cards.dont_say: Don't discount before the buyer has seen their own payback.

their_words.quote: Competitor A quoted us less per user

answer_cards.what_is_fair: Comparing quotes line by line before a yearly commitment is the right move, and the per-technician total matters at their size.
answer_cards.ask_back: Does the quote you have include GPS tracking and the customer portal?

proof.claim: Crewdial vs Competitor A, checked 2026-09-15: GPS tracking and the customer portal are add-ons on Competitor A's listed plan and included in ours

answer_cards.next_step: Send the comparison page (P6) and rebuild both quotes side by side with the same features.
answer_cards.say_it: Comparing quotes is exactly right. On Competitor A's listed plan, GPS tracking and the customer portal are add-ons, and both are included in ours. Does the quote you have include those two? If it helps, I'll lay both quotes side by side.
answer_cards.dont_say: Don't agree that Competitor A is cheaper or mention their offers; say only what the comparison page shows.

their_words.quote: we don't want to be locked in for 12 months

answer_cards.what_is_fair: Signing 12 months with a vendor you have not used yet is a real risk for a small company.
answer_cards.ask_back: If you could leave in the first 90 days, what would still worry you?

proof.claim: 90-day opt-out on the first annual plan, written into the order form

answer_cards.next_step: Point to the opt-out line in the order form (P3) before the proposal goes out, not after the pushback.
answer_cards.say_it: That's a fair worry with a new vendor. Your first annual plan has a 90-day opt-out written into the order form. If you could leave in the first 90 days, what would still worry you?
answer_cards.dont_say: Don't offer terms that are not in the order form, such as month to month.

answer_cards.objection: Our techs won't use an app

their_words.quote: my older techs won't touch a new app

answer_cards.what_is_fair: Techs who dropped an app before will drop the next one too if it slows them down on a job.
answer_cards.ask_back: Which of your techs would be the hardest to win over?

proof.claim: Technician app rated 4.7 on Google Play from 1,300 ratings

answer_cards.next_step: Send the 12-minute training video (P9) to that tech and offer a short check-in call in week one.
answer_cards.say_it: Fair, if it slows them down they'll drop it. The tech app is rated 4.7 on Google Play from 1,300 ratings, and it works offline. Which of your techs would be the hardest to win over? I'll send them the 12-minute training video.
answer_cards.dont_say: Don't promise every tech will love it.

answer_cards.objection: My partner has to sign off

their_words.quote: I need to run it by my partner before anything

answer_cards.what_is_fair: An owner who shares the business should not buy alone.
answer_cards.ask_back: What will your partner ask first: the cost, or what changes for the office?

proof.claim: Owner one-pager: cost per technician, what changes for the office, and payback from the ROI calculator

answer_cards.next_step: Send the owner one-pager (P7) and offer a short call with both owners.
answer_cards.say_it: Makes sense, it's a shared decision. I'll send the owner one-pager with the cost per technician and the payback. What will your partner ask first: the cost, or what changes for the office? Happy to do a short call with both of you.
answer_cards.dont_say: Don't go around the buyer to reach the partner.

their_words.quote: how do we migrate 3 years of service agreements?

answer_cards.what_is_fair: Years of customer and equipment history are the business; losing it would hurt.
answer_cards.ask_back: Where does your customer history live today, and how many years of it do you need?

proof.claim: Our team imports your customer list, equipment records and 2 years of job history in 5 working days

answer_cards.next_step: Book the import scoping call and send the data checklist before the proposal.
answer_cards.say_it: That history is your business, so the worry is right. Our team imports your customer list, equipment records and 2 years of job history in 5 working days. Where does your history live today?
answer_cards.dont_say: Don't say it's easy; say who does the work.

answer_cards.objection: The whiteboard and spreadsheet work fine

their_words.quote: our whiteboard works fine, but I spend 2 hours a day on the phone with techs

answer_cards.what_is_fair: A whiteboard and a spreadsheet do work, and the team already knows them.
answer_cards.ask_back: How many calls a day does the office make just to find out where a tech is?

proof.claim: A plumbing customer with 14 technicians cut drive time 18% in its first 60 days

answer_cards.next_step: Ask for one busy day's dispatch log and time the phone calls; show the same day on the dispatch board.
answer_cards.say_it: It does work, and your team knows it. The cost hides in the phone calls. A 14-technician plumbing customer cut drive time 18% in its first 60 days. How many calls a day does your office make just to find out where a tech is?
answer_cards.dont_say: Don't call their process broken; the buyer built it.

their_words.quote: we run QuickBooks Desktop, does it sync?

answer_cards.what_is_fair: If the books run on QuickBooks Desktop, double entry of every invoice is a real cost.
answer_cards.ask_back: Is moving the books to QuickBooks Online on the table this year?
answer_cards.product_gap: True limit from the product facts: no QuickBooks Desktop sync. Answer honestly, qualify out, and send the count to the product team.
answer_cards.next_step: If the answer is no, qualify out politely and log the deal for the product team.
answer_cards.say_it: Straight answer: we sync with QuickBooks Online only, and Desktop sync isn't planned this year. Is moving the books to QuickBooks Online on the table this year? If not, we're not the right fit yet, and I'd rather tell you now.
answer_cards.dont_say: Don't hint that Desktop sync is coming.

their_words.quote: busy season until November, let's talk then

answer_cards.what_is_fair: Peak season is the worst time to train a team on new software.
answer_cards.ask_back: When does your season slow down enough to give the office two 1-hour sessions?

proof.claim: Go-live plan of 10 working days, with office training in two 1-hour sessions

answer_cards.next_step: Agree a go-live date in the slow season now and book the two training sessions on the calendar.
answer_cards.say_it: Agreed, nobody should learn software in peak season. Go-live takes 10 working days, with office training in two 1-hour sessions. When does your season slow down enough for those two sessions? Let's pick the date now.
answer_cards.dont_say: Don't push for a signature in peak season; book the slow-season date instead.

their_words.quote: we are only 7 techs, feels like overkill for us

answer_cards.what_is_fair: With 5 to 8 technicians the owner can still dispatch by phone, so the gain is smaller.
answer_cards.ask_back: How much of your own day goes to dispatch and chasing invoices?
answer_cards.proof_needed: A customer story from a team with fewer than 8 technicians: hours the owner got back each week.
answer_cards.next_step: Ask about the owner's own hours; collect a customer story from a team under 8 technicians.
answer_cards.say_it: Fair, at your size you can still run it by phone. The question is your own time. How much of your day goes to dispatch and chasing invoices? Let's see what that time is worth to you.
answer_cards.dont_say: Don't quote results from 30-tech customers to a 6-tech shop.
